title: Architecture write-up — GSA full stack + Well-Architected
topic: Six architectural tiers, Well-Architected pillars, security/resilience/cost wins per tier, OLTP vs analytics, edge vs in-VPC cache, integration vs orchestration, portfolio synthesis
format: 15 timed scenario questions (~24 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-33-architecture-writeup.md and gsa-architecture-map.md. Answer without peeking at night-33-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×4 B×4 C×4 D×3 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: An interviewer asks which Well-Architected pillar is best demonstrated by Step Functions execution history, per-step Catch routing, and the Night 26 CloudWatch dashboard for CloudFront cache hit rate. Which pillar fits both?

options.A: Cost Optimization — because Step Functions charges per transition
options.B: Operational Excellence — runbooks, observability, and controlled change
options.C: Sustainability — fewer EC2 instances running overnight
options.D: Performance Efficiency — faster state transitions at the edge

questions.question: Global Ski Atlas wiki static HTML is served from S3 via CloudFront with CachingOptimized, while resort_stats JSON is cached in ElastiCache Redis inside the VPC. A junior architect proposes replacing Redis with CloudFront for DB rows. What is the best response?

options.A: Agree — one CDN layer is always simpler
options.B: Use DynamoDB DAX instead of both layers
options.C: Reject — CloudFront caches HTTP responses at the edge; Redis caches application objects near Aurora in the VPC
options.D: Move Aurora into CloudFront as a custom origin

questions.question: For the GSA pipeline tier, which combination best satisfies Security, Reliability, and Cost in one design?

options.A: Public subnet Fargate with 0.0.0.0/0 on the task SG, EBS for durable output, 24/7 ECS service
options.B: Private subnet scheduled Fargate, task role scoped to S3 output prefix, SQS DLQ + SNS failure fan-out, lifecycle on old iceland/ months
options.C: Lambda with 15-minute timeout for the full Iceland download, Instance Store for GeoParquet
options.D: Single-AZ NAT in two AZs with no endpoints — simplest networking

questions.question: A report asks 'average resorts per country for the last three years.' Live wiki counters update in DynamoDB; historical aggregates live in S3 Iceberg. Which query path matches the analytics tier?

options.A: Aurora writer endpoint with INSERT … SELECT
options.B: Athena SQL on the Glue-cataloged Iceberg table in S3

questions.question: Which control is the strongest Security-pillar example on the edge/frontend tier of globalskiatlas.com?

options.A: CachingDisabled on all CloudFront behaviors to reduce attack surface
options.B: Cognito JWT validation on mutating wiki API methods behind API Gateway
options.C: Storing the Cognito client secret in a public S3 config.json for Lambda cold start speed
options.D: Disabling TLS at CloudFront to inspect traffic in the origin

questions.question: Night 9 VPC uses one NAT Gateway in public subnet AZ-a. Private subnets exist in two AZs. What Reliability caveat belongs in the network-tier write-up?

options.A: NAT Gateway is global — AZ loss has no effect
options.B: If AZ-a is impaired, private workloads may lose outbound internet until NAT is restored or replaced
options.C: S3 gateway endpoints eliminate all NAT failure modes
options.D: Security groups are stateless — NAT return traffic requires NACL edits per flow

questions.question: Exam scenario: monthly Iceland batch runs up to two hours, must enqueue SQS on success, invoke Lambda, and route failures to SNS with different retries per step. Which orchestration choice matches the pipeline tier capstone?

options.A: SQS FIFO with content-based deduplication only
options.B: Kinesis Data Firehose direct to S3
options.C: Step Functions Standard with ecs:runTask.sync and Catch states
options.D: EventBridge schedule with one rule per step and no shared execution history

questions.question: Which Cost Optimization win spans both the analytics tier and the pipeline tier in GSA?

options.A: Store current-month Iceland output in Glacier Deep Archive for fastest retrieval
options.B: Lifecycle aging prefixes on globalskiatlas-backend-k8s-output plus Athena partition filters on lake tables
options.C: Replace S3 with EBS gp3 for all pipeline and lake data
options.D: Run Aurora Serverless v2 at minimum ACU 24/7 for Athena federation

questions.question: Aurora Multi-AZ for resort_stats, DynamoDB PITR for wiki tables, and Route 53 failover with a health check on the PRIMARY record. Which Well-Architected pillar do these primarily support?

options.A: Reliability — failover, backup, and recovery objectives
options.B: Performance Efficiency — lower query latency only
options.D: Sustainability — reduced carbon from edge caching

questions.question: Secrets Manager stores the Cognito client secret; Lambda decrypts via KMS; wiki Lambda runs with least-privilege IAM. Which tier does this primarily document?

options.A: Network — VPC endpoint policy for Secrets Manager
options.B: Application — identity, secrets, and function permissions
options.C: Analytics — encrypting Parquet files at rest in S3
options.D: Pipeline — ECS task role for ECR image pull

questions.question: A partner needs per-API-key rate limits on wiki reads. Which edge/application control is the exam-correct first choice?

options.A: API Gateway usage plan with API key and throttle settings
options.B: Security group rule on the CloudFront distribution
options.C: S3 bucket policy Condition on aws:Referer
options.D: Disable CloudFront and expose API Gateway URL directly without throttling

questions.question: Fargate task definition is 1 vCPU / 2 GiB but CloudWatch p95 CPU is 20% for monthly Iceland runs. Night 31 already rightsized. The bill still shows high NAT Gateway data processing. What tier should the write-up address next?

options.B: Network — S3 gateway and ECR interface endpoints to reduce NAT egress

questions.question: Which pairing correctly maps a GSA exam trap to the right tier?

options.A: Athena for live wiki counter UPSERT — analytics tier best practice
options.B: Durable Iceland GeoParquet on Instance Store — pipeline tier best practice
options.C: Public S3 bucket flagged by Config while CloudFront still serves content — edge/security modernization to OAC + private bucket
options.D: ElastiCache as source of truth for resort_stats — data tier best practice

questions.question: Sustainability lens (awareness): which GSA design choice best reduces wasted compute compared to a always-on EC2 worker polling for monthly work?

options.A: EventBridge schedule triggering RunTask only on the first of the month
options.B: m6i.2xlarge On-Demand running 24/7 with cron inside the OS
options.C: Two NAT Gateways per AZ without endpoints
options.D: Glacier retrieval for every wiki page view

questions.question: You are documenting the full stack for Night 33. Which order is the best interview narrative?

options.A: Start with DynamoDB streams, then VPN, then Glacier vault locks
options.B: Start with user traffic at Route 53/CloudFront, walk through app and data paths, then batch pipeline and VPC underneath
options.C: Start with AWS Backup vault policies only
options.D: Start with Step Functions ASL, ignore edge and OLTP
